curation.notes: FDA ARGOS isolate FDAARGOS_58. Serotype not in metadata - LisSero required for typing. High-quality reference genome. Source: cheese.

reads.download_cmd: fasterq-dump --gzip --outdir data/ SRS891687 && mv data/SRS891687_1.fastq.gz data/reads_1.fq.gz && mv data/SRS891687_2.fastq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz

assembly.download_cmd: datasets download genome accession GCF_001188025.1 --filename data/FDAARGOS_58.zip && unzip -j data/FDAARGOS_58.zip '*.fna' -d data/ && mv data/*.fna data/contigs.fa

validation_instructions.mlst: ST unknown - mlst determines ground truth. All 7 loci must type successfully. Document observed ST and infer lineage.
